api.invalid_input: Check the fields you filled in and try again.
api.invalid_code: Invalid, expired or already used code. Generate another one on the PC with `npm run pair -w @nanachi/daemon`.
api.unauthorized: This phone no longer has access to this machine. Pair again with a new code.
api.forbidden: The daemon refused access (Tailscale check). Check allowedTailscaleLogins.
api.outside_roots: This folder is outside the folders allowed in the daemon (allowedRoots).
api.not_found: Could not find that on the PC. It may have been removed.
api.not_resumable: This agent cannot resume sessions; open a new session.
api.already_linked: This session is already in the app, stopped. Open it and resume.
api.busy: A listing is already in progress for this agent. Wait a few seconds and try again.
api.agent_timeout: The agent did not respond on the PC in time. Try again.
api.agent_failed: The agent did not start on the PC. Check that it is installed and logged in.
api.too_many_sessions: Limit of 8 active sessions; stop one.
api.rate_limited: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
api.network: Could not reach the PC. Check the address and that Tailscale is connected.
api.not_git: This folder is not a git repository.
api.no_commits: The repository has no commits yet.
api.worktree_dirty: The worktree has uncommitted changes; it was kept.
api.unexpected: The server answered in an unexpected way. Is the daemon up to date?

device.expired: This device has not been used for too long, so it lost access to this machine. Pair again with a new code.

workspace.not_a_git_repo: This folder is not a git repository.
workspace.sessions_running: Sessions are running in this workspace. Wait for them to finish or stop them.
workspace.dirty_worktree: There are uncommitted changes. Stash or commit them before switching branches.
workspace.branch_in_use: This branch is open in another worktree.
workspace.branch_exists: A branch with that name already exists.
workspace.branch_not_found: That branch no longer exists on the PC.
workspace.file_exists: A file with that name already exists.
workspace.already_exists: An item with that name already exists.
workspace.file_changed: The file changed on the PC since you opened it.
workspace.dir_not_empty: The folder is not empty. Delete its contents first.
workspace.binary_file: Binary file: it cannot be edited here.
workspace.file_too_large: File too large for the editor (max 2 MB).
workspace.too_many_writes: Too many changes in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

usage.session_not_active: Resume the session to see usage.
usage.session_busy: The agent is busy; try again when it finishes.
usage.usage_unsupported: This agent does not report usage.
usage.timeout: The agent took too long to respond. Try again.

resets.unsupported: This agent has no saved resets

redeem.unconfirmed: Could not confirm whether the reset was used. Check usage before trying again.
redeem.reset_in_progress: A reset is already in progress.
redeem.invalid_request: That reset is no longer in the list. Refresh usage and try again.

loop.loop_not_found: This session has no loop. Create a new one.
loop.loop_finished: This loop has already finished. Create a new one to run again.
loop.loop_busy: A loop round is in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.
loop.not_acp: The loop only runs in agent sessions, not in a terminal.

account.accounts_unsupported: This agent has no extra accounts.
account.account_in_use: A session is working on this account. Wait for it to finish and try again.
account.too_many_accounts: Limit of 10 extra accounts per agent. Remove one before adding another.
account.login_in_progress: A login is already in progress for this agent. Finish or cancel that one first.
account.invalid_state: The login is not waiting for a code right now.
account.session_busy: The agent is working. Switch the account when it finishes.
account.not_resumable: This agent does not resume sessions: open a new session on the account you want to use.
account.not_found: Could not find this account on the PC. Refresh the list.

sessionAccount.not_found: Could not find this session on the PC. It may have been removed.

loginPoll.not_found: The PC no longer remembers this login. Close and try again.
loginPoll.network: No response from the PC. Trying again…
